repos.description: real time face swap and one-click video deepfake with only a single image
repos.summary_zh: Deep-Live-Cam 是一款实时换脸与深度伪造工具，仅需单张源图像即可实现一键视频换脸。核心技术包括实时面部捕捉、嘴部动作保留与多人脸映射，支持 Windows/Mac 平台。适用于内容创作、直播表演、影视娱乐及视频聊天等场景，内置内容审核机制确保合规使用，强调负责任的 AI 应用。
repos.summary_en: Deep-Live-Cam is a real-time face swap and deepfake tool that enables one-click video face replacement with just a single source image. Key technical features include real-time facial capture, mouth mask for natural lip movement preservation, and multi-face mapping for simultaneous subject processing. It supports Windows/Mac platforms and serves content creation, live streaming, film entertainment, and video chat applications. The software incorporates built-in content moderation to prevent misuse and promotes responsible AI usage through ethical guidelines and consent requirements.

repos.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
repos.summary_zh: Headroom 是 AI 智能体的上下文压缩层，能压缩工具输出、日志、RAG 块和文件，减少 60-95% 令牌并保持答案质量。提供 Python/TS 库、代理和 MCP 服务器，支持 Claude、Cursor 等集成。具备可逆 CCR 压缩、跨代理内存共享和失败学习等功能，支持 6 种算法，本地优先，显著提升 LLM 交互效率。
repos.summary_en: Headroom acts as the context optimization layer for LLM applications and AI agents. It compresses tool outputs, logs, RAG chunks, files, DB results, and more before they reach the model, achieving 60-95% token reduction while preserving 100% answer accuracy. Deployable as a Python or TypeScript library, transparent proxy, MCP server, or integrations with LangChain, Agno, Vercel AI SDK, and 100+ LLM providers. Key highlights include reversible CCR compression, smart content detection across formats, persistent hierarchical memory, failure learning that updates agent docs, image compression via ML, cache optimization, and six specialized algorithms. Local-first and multi-agent compatible, it drastically cuts costs and latency for LLM interactions.

repos.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 45 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
repos.summary_zh: 专为Claude Code、Codex、Pi等AI智能体打造的编辑级图表技能。输出纯自包含HTML+SVG，无阴影、无Mermaid粗糙样式，支持架构、流程、序列、Sankey、Wardley等数十种专业类型。可读取网站自动匹配品牌色与字体，默认静态输出，可选无障碍动画，并能重绘draw.io/Mermaid/Excalidraw源图。强调极简密度与焦点设计，让AI生成图表真正达到设计师水准。
repos.summary_en: Editorial diagram skill for Claude Code, Codex, Pi and Agent Skills hosts. Produces self-contained HTML+SVG with no shadows or Mermaid-style clutter. Supports architecture, flowcharts, sequences, Sankey, Wardley maps and dozens more types. Auto-matches brand colors/fonts from your site in seconds. Static by default with optional accessible motion; redraws draw.io, Mermaid or Excalidraw sources. Delivers clean, designer-approved visuals with deliberate low density and focal accents.

repos.description: We write your reusable computer vision tools. 💜
repos.summary_zh: Supervision 是 Roboflow 的开源 Python 计算机视觉库，专注提供可复用 CV 工具。它通过 Detections 对象实现多模型输出统一处理，支持标注可视化、跟踪计数、数据集管理和基准测试。模型无关设计集成主流框架，亮点在于高度可定制工具与高效数据流程，适用于实时视频分析与应用开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Supervision is Roboflow's open-source Python library for computer vision, providing reusable tools for building CV applications. It features a unified Detections object for integrating outputs from models like Ultralytics and Transformers, along with customizable annotators, object tracking, zone counting, dataset conversion between YOLO/COCO/Pascal VOC, and performance benchmarking. Model-agnostic by design, it emphasizes efficient post-processing and cross-framework compatibility, enabling developers to focus on real-time video analysis and application development.

repos.description: Prompt as Code | GPT Image 2 / 2.5 提示词与案例库，530+ 个案例、20+ 套工业级模板与可复用 Skills，新增 2.5 同提示词对比专区，附完整提示词与生成记录，持续更新。
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是GPT-Image2的Prompt as Code工业级提示词引擎与模板库，逆向工程506+案例，涵盖UI、Poster、产品等13类场景，提炼20+工业模板与Agent Skills。配套网站支持提示浏览、复制、筛选与测试生成，助力专业AI图像生成与自动化工作流，持续更新。
repos.summary_en: The awesome-gpt-image-2 repository provides an industrial-grade Prompt as Code engine and template library for GPT-Image2. It features over 506 reverse-engineered cases across 13 categories including UI, posters, products, and photography, plus 20+ industrial templates and Agent Skills. A companion website enables browsing, copying prompts, filtering by style or scene, and testing generations. Designed for professional AI image generation, automation workflows, and agent integration with ongoing updates.

repos.description: Uncensored Open-source alternative to AI video platforms — Free AI image & video generation studio with 800+ models (Flux, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Veo). No content filters. Self-hosted, MIT licensed.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI媒体生成工作室，集成200+先进模型（Flux、Sora、Kling等），提供无过滤的图像视频创作环境。支持自托管与跨平台桌面应用，通过AI编码代理实现提示→生成→编辑→合成的全流程自动化，是商业AI平台的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Open-source AI media generation studio integrating 200+ state-of-the-art models (Flux, Sora, Kling) for unfiltered image/video creation. Features self-hosting, cross-platform desktop apps, and AI agent automation for end-to-end media pipeline orchestration. MIT-licensed alternative to commercial platforms.

repos.description: 🚀 AI 全自动短视频引擎 | AI Fully Automated Short Video Engine
repos.summary_zh: Pixelle-Video是一款AI全自动短视频引擎。输入主题后自动完成文案撰写、AI配图视频生成、语音合成与视频合成。支持多种AI模型及ComfyUI集成，提供数字人口播和动作迁移功能。零门槛模块化设计，适用于内容创作和营销场景。
repos.summary_en: Pixelle-Video is an AI fully automated short video engine. Simply input a theme, and it auto-generates scripts, AI visuals, voice narration, BGM, and the complete video. It integrates LLMs, TTS, image/video gen models via direct APIs or ComfyUI/RunningHub, with modules for digital humans, image-to-video, and action transfer. Modular design offers zero-threshold creation, perfect for content marketing and social media videos without any editing expertise. The web interface provides easy template and model selection for customized outputs.

repos.description: AI-agent Skill for generating polished HTML slide decks: editorial magazine and Swiss layouts, image prompts, social covers, and a WebGL/low-power presentation runtime.
repos.summary_zh: 为AI Agent提供高质量HTML PPT生成能力，内置电子杂志与瑞士国际主义双视觉系统，支持单文件横向翻页演示、多平台封面生成及Codex配图流程。解决AI生成PPT的视觉质量控制难题，适用于个人风格演讲、产品发布及方法论展示，输出无需构建、可直接打开的HTML文件。
repos.summary_en: An AI Agent skill for generating polished HTML slide decks with dual visual systems: editorial magazine and Swiss internationalist styles. Enables single-file horizontal presentations, multi-platform social covers, and Codex-integrated image generation. Solves visual quality control for AI-generated slides, ideal for personal talks, product launches, and methodology showcases with zero-build delivery.

repos.description: Maple Mono: Open source monospace font with round corner, ligatures and Nerd-Font icons for IDE and terminal, fine-grained customization options. 带连字和控制台图标的圆角等宽字体，中英文宽度完美2:1，细粒度的自定义选项
repos.summary_zh: Maple Mono 是一款开源等宽字体，专为提升代码阅读体验设计。核心亮点包括圆角美学、智能连字和完整的 Nerd-Font 图标支持。其独特的中英文 2:1 宽度对齐技术，在多语言混排和 Markdown 表格中实现完美视觉对齐。V7 版本采用可变字体技术，支持无级字重调节和细粒度特性控制，适配各类 IDE 和终端环境。
repos.summary_en: Maple Mono is an open-source monospace font designed to enhance coding workflow. Key features include rounded corners, smart ligatures, and comprehensive Nerd-Font icon integration. Its unique 2:1 Chinese-English width alignment ensures perfect visual harmony in multilingual code and Markdown tables. The V7 remake introduces variable font technology with infinite weight control and granular customization options, optimized for IDEs and terminals.

repos.description: :rocket: The Ultimate Image Uploader for Efficient Creators. Supports Obsidian, Typora, VS Code etc. and 60+ image hosting services  (S3, GitHub, Cloudflare R2, Imgur, Aliyun OSS...). Paste, upload, done.
repos.summary_zh: PicGo是专为创作者设计的终极图片上传工具，无缝集成Obsidian、VS Code、Typora等主流编辑器。支持60+图床服务（GitHub、阿里云OSS、S3等），通过拖拽/粘贴/快捷键实现秒传并自动复制链接。独创插件系统可扩展支持Cloudflare R2等新兴存储，彻底消除写作中的上下文切换，让创作者专注内容生产。
repos.summary_en: PicGo is the ultimate image uploader for efficient creators, seamlessly integrating with Obsidian, VS Code, Typora and other editors. Supporting 60+ image hosts (GitHub, Alibaba Cloud OSS, AWS S3), it enables instant uploads via drag-and-drop/clipboard/hotkeys with auto-copied links. Its extensible plugin system adds support for Cloudflare R2 and more, eliminating context switching to maximize creative focus.

repos.description: A curated collection of fun and creative examples generated with Nano Banana & Nano Banana Pro🍌, Gemini-2.5-flash-image based model. We also release Nano-consistent-150K openly to support the community's development of image generation and unified models(click to website to see our blog)
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是 Nano Banana 模型的创意图像案例库，基于 Gemini-2.5-flash-image 架构。精选 30+ 跨领域应用实例，涵盖艺术创作、设计工作流到商业内容生成。核心贡献是开源 Nano-consistent-150K 数据集，通过单人物 35+ 种编辑变体实现严格身份一致性，支持交错数据构建，为图像生成与统一模型开发提供高质量基准。
repos.summary_en: This repository showcases Nano Banana model's creative image generation capabilities, powered by Gemini-2.5-flash-image. It curates 30+ cross-domain applications from artistic creation to design workflows. The key contribution is the open-sourced Nano-consistent-150K dataset, which enforces character identity consistency through 35+ editing variations per subject, enabling interleaved data construction for image generation and unified model development.

repos.description: Rebuild the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural, quality-gated, animation-ready Three.js model. Token-efficient image-to-3D.
repos.summary_zh: img2threejs 是一个面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude）的开源技能，可将单张参考图像重建为代码生成的程序化 Three.js 3D 模型。它采用多阶段雕刻管道、严格质量门控、细节清单和代理视觉审查，确保比例、材质、细节高保真；Python 脚本处理验证与状态管理，实现令牌高效，输出为动画就绪的 TypeScript 代码（含枢轴、插槽），支持硬表面对象与角色。适用于网页 3D 应用、游戏道具与交互体验，重建方式为代码而非网格或摄影测量。
repos.summary_en: img2threejs is an open-source skill for AI coding agents (e.g., Claude) that reconstructs a single reference image into a code-only, procedural Three.js 3D model. It uses a multi-stage sculpting pipeline with strict quality gates, detail inventory, and agent-vision reviews for high-fidelity proportions, materials, and details. Python stdlib scripts handle validation and state for token efficiency, with the LLM focused on judgment. Outputs are animation-ready TypeScript factories from primitives and shaders, supporting hard-surface objects and characters. Ideal for web 3D apps, game props, and interactive experiences via code reconstruction rather than meshes.

repos.description: 一站式原生AI PPT生成应用，几分钟内生成一套幻灯片; 支持上传任意模板图片，上传任意素材&智能解析，一句话/大纲/页面描述自动生成PPT，口头修改指定区域、一键导出可编辑ppt、视频等 - An AI-native slides generator based on nano banana/gpt-image🏞️
repos.summary_zh: 基于 nano banana pro 的 AI 原生 PPT 生成器，实现真正的'Vibe PPT'。支持一句话/大纲生成、自然语言修改、智能素材解析与自定义模板，突破传统工具同质化限制。一键导出可编辑 PPTX/PDF，适用于职场提案、教学课件、学生作业等场景，大幅降低专业演示文稿制作门槛。
repos.summary_en: An AI-native PPT generator built on nano banana pro, pioneering the 'Vibe PPT' concept. It enables creation via natural language prompts, outlines, or page descriptions, with intelligent material parsing and custom template support. Features vocal modification, one-click editable PPTX/PDF export, breaking traditional tools' homogeneity. Ideal for business proposals, educational content, and student projects, democratizing professional presentation design.

repos.description: 中文小黑怪诞正文配图生成 Skill | 16:9 白底手绘 | 少量红橙蓝批注 | Codex Skill
repos.summary_zh: Codex Skill，专为中文文章生成16:9白底手绘怪诞正文配图。以“小黑”IP为核心角色参与动作，提炼认知锚点转化为流程、状态或隐喻图，配少量红橙蓝中文批注，适合知识内容与方法论插图，强调记忆点而非信息图。
repos.summary_en: A Codex Skill that turns Chinese articles into 16:9 white-background hand-drawn surreal illustrations. Centered on the “Xiaohei” character actively performing key actions, it visualizes cognitive anchors as processes, states or metaphors with sparse red-orange-blue annotations, ideal for knowledge and methodology content.

repos.description: An image-to-world skillset for Claude.
repos.summary_zh: image-blaster 是一款基于 Claude AI 的图像转3D世界工具，5分钟内从单张图片生成可探索的3D环境、动态物体模型和音效。集成 World Labs Marble、Hunyuan 3D 和 FAL 等模型，支持 Unity/Unreal/Blender 等主流平台，为游戏开发、影视场景和建筑可视化提供自动化3D内容创作能力。
repos.summary_en: image-blaster is a revolutionary Claude AI-powered image-to-world skillset that transforms any single image into a fully realized 3D environment in under 5 minutes. The system intelligently orchestrates World Labs Marble for explorable Gaussian splat environments, Hunyuan 3D via FAL for textured mesh generation, and ElevenLabs for immersive sound effects. Designed for seamless integration with Unity, Unreal, Godot, Blender, and Three.js, it dramatically accelerates workflows in game development, film location scouting, architectural visualization, and robotics simulation.

repos.description: 🤖 A minimal and customizable Docker image running the Android emulator as a service.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供基于Alpine的最小化Docker镜像，用于将Android模拟器作为服务运行。支持KVM硬件加速和GPU加速（CUDA），可自定义Android版本与设备类型，内置ADB端口转发，兼容scrcpy远程控屏。专为CI/CD农场设计，提供无头运行模式，镜像体积可压缩至138MB（不含SDK），适用于自动化测试与远程Android开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Repository provides a minimal Alpine-based Docker image that runs Android emulator as a service. Features KVM hardware acceleration and GPU support (CUDA), customizable Android versions/device types, built-in ADB port forwarding, and scrcpy compatibility for remote screen control. Designed for headless CI/CD farms, the image can be compressed to 138MB (SDK-free variant). Ideal for automated testing and remote Android development with optimized performance and network accessibility.

repos.description: ⚠️ Browser fingerprinting via favicon!
repos.summary_zh: Supercookie 通过 favicon 缓存机制实现浏览器持久指纹追踪，为访客分配独特且难以清除的 ID。该 ID 在隐身模式、清除缓存、重启系统或使用 VPN/AdBlocker 后仍有效。项目仅用于教育演示，旨在揭示 favicon 跟踪的隐私风险。技术亮点包括跨会话持久性、实时 API 演示及 Node.js/Docker 部署，适用于隐私安全研究与开发者警示。
repos.summary_en: Supercookie demonstrates persistent browser fingerprinting via favicon caching, assigning unique, hard-to-clear IDs to visitors. The ID survives incognito mode, cache clears, browser restarts, VPNs, and ad blockers. Built for educational purposes only, it highlights privacy risks from favicon tracking. Key features include cross-session persistence, live demo APIs, and easy deployment with Node.js and Docker, ideal for security research and awareness.

repos.description: ChatGPT 官网接口纯协议逆向实现，Go 语言编写，高并发、低内存、高性能。指纹级请求还原，支持 GPT-Image-2.6 生图/改图、GIF 动图、文本模型与语音合成/转写，兼容 OpenAI 接口协议，在线批量生图，号池管理，支持导入 CPA、sub2api 号池，可接入 Cherry Studio、New API 等软件
repos.summary_zh: 本项目逆向ChatGPT官网接口，实现OpenAI兼容的图片生成与编辑API，支持gpt-image-2等模型。提供账号池管理、Docker自托管及在线画图功能，兼容Cherry Studio，适用于个人图像服务。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT2API is a reverse-engineered implementation of ChatGPT's official interfaces, offering OpenAI-compatible APIs for image generation and editing using models like gpt-image-2. It features account pool management with automatic quota refresh, multiple import methods including CPA and sub2api, proxy support, and Docker self-hosting. Includes an online drawing workbench and compatibility with tools like Cherry Studio and New API. Ideal for personal, non-commercial image generation and editing services with sustained account usage.

repos.description: A compact Agent Skill for highly simplified, rounded, subtly neo-skeuomorphic IP mascot logos.
repos.summary_zh: 紧凑型Agent Skill，专为AI智能体生成极度简化、圆润可爱的公司级IP吉祥物。强调4-7个基本形状的粗壮剪影、三色语义配色、下角主导构图与微妙新拟物深度，兼容Codex、Coze、Doubao等主流Agent及顶级图像模型，输出可商用的可爱方图。
repos.summary_en: A compact Agent Skill that enables AI agents to generate extremely simple, cute, company-ready IP mascot logos. It enforces bold rounded silhouettes from 4–7 shapes, three semantic colors, lower-corner dominance and subtle neo-skeuomorphic depth. Compatible with Codex, Coze, Doubao and top image models; produces commercially usable square character assets.

repos.description: 一款专注于 AI 多模态翻译的工具，一键自动翻译 RPG/SLG 游戏、Epub/TXT 小说、PDF/Word/MD 文档、Srt/Ass/Vtt 字幕，以及漫画图片、音频与视频等内容。
repos.summary_zh: AiNiee 是一款专注于复杂长文本 AI 翻译的工具，支持游戏、电子书、文档、字幕等全格式一键翻译。采用思维链翻译、上下文关联和 AI 术语表技术突破长文本翻译局限，深度适配 Mtool、Renpy 等游戏提取工具，提供术语提取、AI 润色等质量控制功能，实现高效高质量的多领域翻译。
repos.summary_en: AiNiee is an AI-powered translation tool specialized in complex long-text translation across games, ebooks, documents, and subtitles. It employs chain-of-thought translation, contextual association, and AI glossary to overcome long-text limitations. With deep integration of game extraction tools like Mtool and Renpy, it offers terminology extraction and AI polishing features for efficient, high-quality multilingual translation.

repos.description: Remove visible and invisible AI watermarks from images and video, and AI provenance metadata from images, video, and audio. Python library, CLI, and agent skill for SynthID, C2PA, EXIF, IPTC, XMP, and common generative-AI marks. By Victor Kuznetsov.
repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库提供CLI和库，用于移除AI生成图像的可见和不可见水印。支持Gemini、DALL-E、Stable Diffusion等主流模型，采用反向alpha混合算法快速移除Gemini的sparkle logo，通过扩散模型再生消除SynthID等不可见水印，并剥离C2PA、EXIF等元数据。具备智能人脸保护和批量处理能力，可绕过社交媒体AI检测。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive CLI and library solution for removing both visible and invisible AI watermarks from images generated by major models such as Google Gemini, OpenAI DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, and Midjourney. It employs a novel reverse alpha blending algorithm to deterministically remove the Gemini/Nano Banana sparkle logo in under 0.05 seconds without GPU requirements, using a three-stage NCC detector for dynamic positioning. For invisible watermarks including SynthID, StableSignature, and TreeRing, it utilizes diffusion-based regeneration at native SDXL resolution (~1024px) with controlled noise addition and denoising. The tool comprehensively strips AI metadata (C2PA manifests, EXIF, XMP, PNG text chunks), removes "Made with AI" labels that trigger social media flags, and features Smart Face Protection to prevent AI distortion. Additional capabilities include Analog Humanizer adding film grain to bypass AI classifiers and efficient batch processing for directories.

repos.description: 🏞️ PicX，免费、安全的一站式在线图片处理平台。
repos.summary_zh: PicX 是一款基于 GitHub API 的在线图床管理工具，无需下载安装即可使用。它支持拖拽上传、批量操作、图片压缩和水印处理，提供 Markdown/HTML 等多种链接格式。通过 GitHub OAuth 或 Token 认证，用户可将 GitHub 仓库作为免费图床，配合 jsDelivr 等 CDN 实现高速访问，是开发者和技术写作者的理想图片托管解决方案。
repos.summary_en: PicX is a GitHub API-based online image hosting management tool that requires no download or installation. It supports drag-and-drop upload, batch operations, image compression, and watermarking, providing multiple link formats like Markdown/HTML. Through GitHub OAuth or Token authentication, users can leverage GitHub repositories as free image hosts, combined with CDNs like jsDelivr for high-speed access, making it an ideal image hosting solution for developers and technical writers.

repos.description: 🤹 Access thousands of icons as components on-demand universally.
repos.summary_zh: unplugin-icons 是基于 Iconify 的通用图标组件库，提供超20万图标并支持150+图标集。通过按需加载机制仅打包实际使用的图标，显著减小构建体积。支持 Vite、Webpack 等主流构建工具及 React、Vue 3 等框架，具备自动导入、SSR/SSG 友好、自定义图标等特性，适用于现代前端项目。
repos.summary_en: unplugin-icons is a universal icon library leveraging Iconify, providing 200,000+ icons across 150+ sets. It enables on-demand loading to bundle only used icons, reducing bundle size. Compatible with major build tools (Vite, Webpack, Rollup) and frameworks (React, Vue 3, Svelte), it features auto-importing, custom icons, and SSR/SSG support without FOUC for modern web development.

repos.description: Image Hosting solution, Flickr/imgur alternative, make it easy for users to share their images. Using Cloudflare Pages and Telegraph.
repos.summary_zh: Telegraph-Image 是基于 Cloudflare Pages 和 Telegram Channel 的免费图床方案，替代 Flickr/imgur。核心价值：无限存储（单图5MB限制）、零服务器成本、自动绑定 pages.dev 域名或自定义域名。技术亮点包括可选 AI 图片审查、后台管理（网格/瀑布流视图）、批量删除与分页功能，完全依赖 Cloudflare 免费额度运营。
repos.summary_en: Telegraph-Image is a free image hosting solution using Cloudflare Pages and Telegram Channel as a Flickr/imgur alternative. Key value: unlimited storage (5MB/image cap), zero server cost, automatic *.pages.dev domain or custom domain binding. Technical highlights include optional AI image moderation, backend management (grid/waterfall views), batch operations, and full operation within Cloudflare's free tier limits.

repos.description: 自建 Docker 镜像加速与管理服务。零磁盘缓存、可视化面板、支持上游账号认证，支持一键部署Docker、K8s、Quay、Ghcr、Mcr、elastic、nvcr等镜像加速
repos.summary_zh: 该项目提供一键部署的Docker镜像加速服务，基于官方Registry支持Docker Hub、K8s、Quay等主流仓库代理。支持自动配置反向代理（Nginx/Caddy）、缓存控制、IP黑白名单及私有镜像拉取，解决国内镜像下载慢和频率限制问题。可部署在自有服务器或ClawCloud/Render等免费平台，附带Web管理面板实现镜像搜索与容器监控。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a one-click deployable Docker image acceleration service based on the official Registry, supporting proxies for Docker Hub, K8s, Quay, and other major registries. It features automatic reverse proxy (Nginx/Caddy) setup, cache control, IP whitelisting/blacklisting, and private image pulling to address slow downloads and rate limits in China. It can be deployed on private servers or free platforms like ClawCloud/Render, with a web management panel for image search and container monitoring.

repos.description: Virtual DSM in a Docker container.
repos.summary_zh: vdsm/virtual-dsm 是一个创新的轻量级 NAS 解决方案，通过在 Docker 容器中虚拟化运行 Synology DSM 系统，结合 KVM 硬件加速技术实现接近原生的性能表现。项目支持多磁盘管理、物理设备直通、CPU 与内存灵活配置，可快速部署于 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 平台，适用于个人私有云存储、开发测试环境及轻量级生产场景。
repos.summary_en: vdsm/virtual-dsm is an innovative lightweight NAS solution that virtualizes Synology DSM within Docker containers, leveraging KVM hardware acceleration to deliver near-native performance. This project provides comprehensive storage virtualization capabilities including multi-disk management, raw device passthrough, and dynamic resource allocation for CPU and memory. With support for Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and GitHub Codespaces, it enables rapid deployment across Linux, Windows, and macOS platforms. The solution is particularly suited for personal cloud storage, development testing environments, and scenarios requiring flexible, containerized NAS infrastructure with enterprise-grade features.

repos.description: A vector graphics application for structured SVG editing, available on all major desktop platforms and on web. Currently in late alpha.
repos.summary_zh: GodSVG 是一款结构化 SVG 编辑器，直接操作 SVG 源码而非添加元数据，实现 UI 与代码实时双向同步。生成干净、精确、优化的矢量文件，适合设计师与开发者对图形进行像素级控制。支持桌面与 Web 平台，目前处于晚期 alpha 阶段，强调低抽象工作流。
repos.summary_en: GodSVG is a structured SVG editor that fundamentally differs from traditional tools by directly manipulating SVG source code without metadata overhead. It enables real-time bidirectional sync between visual editing and code view, producing clean, precise, and highly optimized vector files. Designed for designers and developers requiring pixel-perfect control, it runs on desktop and web platforms in late alpha stage.

repos.description: Javascript library for generating identicons. Running in the browser and on Node.js.
repos.summary_zh: Jdenticon 是一个轻量级 JavaScript 库，用于生成高识别度的 identicon 头像。它支持 SVG 和 Canvas 渲染，可在浏览器和 Node.js 环境中运行。通过确定性哈希算法，相同输入始终生成一致的视觉图标，完美适合作为用户头像占位符。库体积小巧，零依赖，并提供 React、Angular 等主流框架的集成方案，是构建用户标识系统的理想选择。
repos.summary_en: Jdenticon is a lightweight JavaScript library for generating highly recognizable identicon avatars. Supporting both SVG and Canvas rendering, it runs in browsers and Node.js. Using deterministic hash algorithms, identical inputs always produce consistent visual icons, making it perfect for user avatar placeholders. With minimal bundle size, zero dependencies, and official integrations for React, Angular, and other frameworks, it's an ideal solution for user identification systems.

repos.description: AI Agent Skill to generate and render beautiful Mermaid diagrams as SVG or terminal ASCII — 15 themes, 6 diagram types, batch CLI, no browser.
repos.summary_zh: 专为AI Agent设计的Mermaid图表渲染技能，本地无浏览器生成精美SVG/PNG/终端ASCII，支持15主题、6种图类型（流程图/时序/状态/类/ER/XY）与批量CLI，无缝集成Claude Code、Cursor等环境。
repos.summary_en: AI Agent skill for rendering beautiful Mermaid diagrams locally without a browser. Outputs themed SVG, PNG, or terminal ASCII/Unicode. Supports 15 themes, 6 diagram types, batch CLI, and seamless integration with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI coding tools.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Pages 和 Next.js 的 Serverless 图床服务。利用 Cloudflare 免费额度实现无限存储且零成本运营，无需自备服务器和域名。集成内容审核 API 自动屏蔽不良图片，提供完整的后台管理系统，支持访问统计、黑白名单管控，并可配置 Telegram 机器人实时通知。
repos.summary_en: A Serverless image hosting service built on Cloudflare Pages and Next.js. Offers unlimited storage at zero cost within Cloudflare's free tier, eliminating the need for self-hosted servers and domains. Features automated content moderation API for inappropriate images, a full-featured admin panel with access analytics, IP/referer whitelisting/blacklisting, and configurable Telegram bot notifications.

repos.description: Skill and MCP server for searching and retrieving icons
repos.summary_zh: Better Icons 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的 MCP 服务器和 CLI 工具，支持从 150 多个图标集合中搜索检索 20 万以上图标。它帮助 Cursor、Claude 等 AI 编码代理准确获取图标 SVG，避免 token 浪费和样式不一致，支持多框架导出、项目文件同步、自动学习用户偏好及批量/相似图标检索，有效提升 AI 辅助开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Better Icons is a specialized MCP server and CLI tool for AI agents, enabling search and retrieval of over 200,000 icons from 150+ collections. It assists coding assistants like Cursor and Claude in accurately fetching icons and SVGs, avoiding token waste on inline code. Key capabilities include auto-learning preferences, direct project file syncing, batch retrieval, cross-collection similar icons, and exports for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid plus raw SVG.

repos.description: WebAI2API: 基于 Camoufox 的网页 AI 转 API 工具，支持 LMArena/Gemini等，多窗口并发与账号隔离。 | Web AI to OpenAI API via Camoufox. Supports LMArena/Gemini and more, multi-window concurrency & account isolation.
repos.summary_zh: WebAI2API是基于Camoufox的网页AI服务转API工具，支持LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT等20+平台。通过拟人化操作模拟规避检测，提供OpenAI格式接口，支持多窗口并发与账号级浏览器隔离，内置任务队列和故障转移机制，配备可视化管理界面，实现高效稳定的AI服务调用。
repos.summary_en: WebAI2API converts web-based AI services (LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT etc.) into OpenAI-compatible APIs using Camoufox. It simulates human-like interactions to bypass detection, supports multi-window concurrency with account isolation, and includes task queuing, failover mechanisms, plus a web management interface for stable AI service integration.

repos.description: 使用Telegram作为存储的文件外链系统，不限制文件大小和格式。
repos.summary_zh: tgState 是一款创新的文件外链系统，深度利用 Telegram 的 Bot API 和 FileID 机制，将 Telegram 频道/群组作为无限容量存储后端。系统支持任意大小格式的文件存储分发，提供 Web 界面和 API 上传接口，可作为图床或私有网盘使用。支持 Docker、Vercel 等多种部署方式，配合 CloudFlare 可实现高效 CDN 加速。
repos.summary_en: tgState is an innovative file hosting system that leverages Telegram's Bot API and FileID mechanism to utilize Telegram channels/groups as unlimited-capacity storage backend. Supporting files of any size and format, it provides both web interface and API for uploads, functioning as image hosting or private cloud storage. Features flexible deployment via Docker, Vercel, or binary, with CloudFlare CDN integration for optimized content delivery.

repos.description: Plug-and-play JSON style prompts for Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image & Midjourney. Copy one style.json, get a consistent look. New styles every week.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库精选68个可复用的JSON提示模板库，专为AI图像生成提供结构化视觉风格参考。每个style.json封装提示模板、变量、风格锚点与示例，支持ChatGPT、Claude等LLM即插即用，实现一致、可迭代的图像输出。涵盖涂鸦、海报、拼贴、编辑等类别，解决一次性文本提示难以复用的问题。每日更新，附预览与目录，适合设计师与内容创作者构建专业视觉工作流。
repos.summary_en: This repo curates 68 reusable JSON prompt templates for consistent AI image generation. Each style.json packages visual design references into structured prompts with variables, fidelity anchors, and examples for plug-and-play use in LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude. It solves inconsistent one-off prompts by enabling repeatable styles across doodle, poster, collage, editorial, and travel themes. Updated daily with previews and catalog; ideal for designers seeking reliable, high-quality visual outputs in multimodal workflows.
